Hi Andrea,

Thanks for writing, and sorry the fans are a sticking point.

Two things on the B30. Our spec sheet lists it at about 50 dB with fan and heatsink cooling, and it doesn't state the fan size, so I'm getting the exact fan detail confirmed rather than guessing at it. The current B30 batch ships October 30.

Before anything gets cancelled, it's worth knowing a swap costs you nothing, while cancelling an unshipped pre-sale carries a 10% restocking fee. If you want to keep the hashrate, the Magic Miner 40T is $799 for 40 TH/s, dual fan, about 50 dB in Eco, shipping November 14. If quiet is the real priority, the NerdQX is $299 for 8 TH/s with a 120 mm front fan and a 90 mm rear fan at about 40 dB, in stock now. That is a lot less hashrate, so I'd only suggest it if noise decides it for you. I can do either swap on your existing order myself.

One thing I need from you: the email address on order Shop····, so I can open it and act on it. Reply with that and your choice, and I'll take it from there.

A colleague on our team is picking this up today as well, so if you'd rather just have the refund, you'll get confirmation from us either way.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
